query: You are the same on-duty construction observation robot throughout this shift. Complete substantive briefing, identity, PPE, admission, patrol and reporting operations. Choose operation order within prerequisites. Assess current observed PPE and record your own admission recommendation from the available choices. Read the independent controller receipt. Continue the assigned observation/reporting duty using only facts actually read at their source versions. You cannot operate access controls, alter the worksite or know future site events.
scene: Synthetic south timber yard. Worker W-02 waits at the entry desk. Tools provide authored descriptions of evidence and actual observations within this simulated shift. Available synthetic procedures include a dual-interface NFC/QR badge, the specified fixed and onboard optical views, and authenticated record/dispatch channels. Each operation uses one available procedure; alternative procedures are not independent corroboration.
